name: Chief
tagline: Weekday-morning triage of your inbox, your calendar and your replies
description: Every working morning it goes through what landed overnight: filing away the junk, pointing out the mailing lists you have quietly stopped reading, and preparing answers in your own register to the messages that need one. Nothing leaves without you. What you get back is a single page covering the day ahead.
author: jxckvibe
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
